marker.skipCredits.description: Button shown during video playback, on phone and TV, that jumps past the end credits.

marker.skipRecap.description: Button shown during video playback, on phone and TV, that jumps past the recap of earlier episodes.

picker.add.description: Short button label on the phone's profile and account picker for adding a new entry. Opens a choice of adding a server, account or profile.

picker.addAccount.description: Phone picker menu row title for adding another account on a server already saved on this device.

picker.addAccountDetail.description: Smaller explanatory line under the Add an account row in the phone picker.

picker.addProfile.description: Phone picker menu row title for adding a new profile under the current account.

picker.addProfileDetail.description: Smaller explanatory line under the Add a profile row in the phone picker.

picker.addServer.description: Phone picker menu row title for connecting to an additional Silo server.

picker.addServerDetail.description: Smaller explanatory line under the Add a server row in the phone picker.

picker.changeAccount.description: Phone picker button or row for switching to a different account on the current server.

picker.signInAgain.description: Phone picker button for an account whose session expired, so the user signs in to it again.

platform.androidTv.description: Device type name for an Android TV, shown on the phone when a TV asks to be signed in.

platform.appleTv.description: Device type name for an Apple TV, shown on the phone when a TV asks to be signed in.

remote.battery.message.description: Body of a phone dialog explaining that battery restrictions can disconnect Remote Control (controlling a TV or player from the phone) once the app is in the background. Names the system settings entries to choose.

remote.battery.notNow.description: Dialog button on the phone that dismisses the Remote Control battery prompt without changing settings.

remote.battery.settings.description: Dialog button on the phone that opens the system battery settings for the app.

remote.battery.title.description: Title of the phone dialog about battery restrictions affecting the Remote Control connection.

remote.replace.title.description: Title of a phone confirmation dialog in Remote Control, asked before starting new media on a device that is already playing something.

signInTv.accountUnconfirmed.description: Phone message when the app could not verify the signed-in account on a server. {server}: the server name.

signInTv.addAccount.description: Phone button on the Sign in a TV screen to add an account on a server, so it can be used to approve the TV. {server}: the server name.

signInTv.approve.description: Phone button on the Sign in a TV screen that approves the TV's sign-in request.

signInTv.cardTitle.description: Phone card title asking whether to sign in a named TV. {device}: the name of the TV, for example Living Room TV.

signInTv.cardTitleGeneric.description: Phone card title asking whether to sign in a TV whose name is unknown.

signInTv.checkCode.description: Phone label above the sign-in code, telling the user to check that the TV displays the same code.

signInTv.chooseAccountBody.description: Phone body text on the account choice screen, for approving a TV with a different account. {server}: the server name.

signInTv.chooseAccountTitle.description: Phone screen title for picking which account approves the TV.

signInTv.codeLabel.description: Phone label for the text field where the user types the sign-in code shown on the TV.

signInTv.continue.description: Phone button that submits the entered TV code and moves to the next step.

signInTv.declined.description: Phone message shown after the user declined the TV sign-in request.

signInTv.error.alreadySignedIn.description: Phone error when the TV was already signed in by an earlier approval.

signInTv.error.canceled.description: Phone error when the TV cancelled the sign-in attempt before it was approved.

signInTv.error.declined.description: Phone error when the sign-in request was declined.

signInTv.error.enterCode.description: Phone validation error when the user submits without a code from the TV.

signInTv.error.expired.description: Phone error when the entered code had expired. The TV has generated a new code the user should scan or enter.

signInTv.error.generic.description: Phone generic error when approving the TV's sign-in failed.

signInTv.error.network.description: Phone error for a network failure while approving the TV sign-in.

signInTv.error.notFound.description: Phone error when the entered code does not match any TV sign-in request.

signInTv.error.notFoundOn.description: Phone error when the entered code was not found on the selected server. {server}: the server name.

signInTv.error.providerUnavailable.description: Phone error when the external sign-in provider could not be reached to confirm the account. The user remains signed in on the phone.

signInTv.error.signInFirst.description: Phone error shown when the user tries to approve a TV without being signed in on the phone.

signInTv.followCanceled.description: Phone status after approval, saying the TV stopped the sign-in.

signInTv.followDenied.description: Phone status after approval, saying the sign-in was declined.

signInTv.followExpired.description: Phone status saying the code expired before the TV finished signing in.

signInTv.followTimedOut.description: Phone status after approval when the app stopped waiting for confirmation. Tells the user to look at the TV to see whether it signed in.

signInTv.network.description: Phone line on the TV request card naming the network the request came from. {network}: the network or location name, for example an IP address or city.

signInTv.notNow.description: Phone button that dismisses the TV sign-in request without approving it.

signInTv.platformRequested.description: Phone card subtitle about a TV sign-in request. {platform}: the TV type, such as Android TV; {time}: when it was requested, such as 5 minutes ago or just now.

signInTv.profilesNote.description: Phone note on the TV approval screen about privacy: profiles are visible to anyone using that TV, and PIN-protected profiles stay locked.

signInTv.requested.description: Phone card line saying when the TV sign-in request was made. {time}: relative time, such as 5 minutes ago or just now.

signInTv.requestedJustNow.description: Phone relative-time phrase for a request made moments ago, inserted into the Requested line.

signInTv.serverAccount.description: Phone text on the TV approval card explaining what will happen. {server}: the server name; {account}: the account name that will be used.

signInTv.serverHint.description: Phone hint under the server row, telling the user the TV shows the name of the server it is signing in to.

signInTv.serverLabel.description: Phone row label above the name of the server the TV will sign in to.

signInTv.serverOnly.description: Phone text on the TV approval card explaining what will happen. {server}: the server name.

signInTv.serverWithHost.description: Phone display of a server with its address in parentheses. {server}: the server's display name; {host}: its host address, such as media.example.com.

signInTv.settingsLabel.description: Phone Settings row label that opens the screen for approving a TV's sign-in request.

signInTv.signInFirst.description: Phone button shown when the user is not signed in, leading to the sign-in screen before approving a TV.

signInTv.signedIn.description: Phone success message after the TV has finished signing in.

signInTv.signingIn.description: Phone success message after approval while the TV completes its sign-in.

signInTv.subtitle.description: Phone subtitle under the Sign in a TV title, instructing the user to type the TV's code.

signInTv.switchAccount.description: Phone link below the account name, for users who are signed in as the wrong person and want to switch accounts.

signInTv.switchThisServer.description: Phone fallback word for the server name inside the add-account button when no server name is available. Reads as part of Add an account on this server.

signInTv.title.description: Phone screen title for approving a TV's device sign-in.

signInTv.tryServer.description: Phone button suggesting a different saved server to try for the entered code. {server}: the server's display name.

signInTv.warning.description: Phone safety warning on the approval card: only approve a TV that the user can see and started themselves.

tab.downloads.description: Phone bottom navigation tab label for downloaded offline media.

tab.home.description: Phone bottom navigation tab label for the Home screen.

tab.search.description: Phone bottom navigation tab label for Search.

tab.settings.description: Phone bottom navigation tab label for Settings.

nav.browse.description: Android TV side navigation item for browsing the library. Short, space is limited.

nav.home.description: Android TV side navigation item for the Home screen. Short, space is limited.

nav.search.description: Android TV side navigation item for Search. Short, space is limited.

nav.settings.description: Android TV side navigation item for Settings. Short, space is limited.

tvPair.error.alreadySignedIn.description: Android TV error when another device is already signed in with this pairing request.

tvPair.error.canceled.description: Android TV error when the phone or other device stopped the sign-in.

tvPair.error.declined.description: Android TV error when the sign-in was declined.

tvPair.error.enterCode.description: Android TV validation error on the screen where this TV approves another device's sign-in, when no code was entered.

tvPair.error.expired.description: Android TV error when the entered code expired. The other device shows a replacement code.

tvPair.error.generic.description: Android TV generic error when approving another device failed.

tvPair.error.network.description: Android TV error for a network failure while approving another device.

tvPair.error.notFound.description: Android TV error when the entered code does not match any pending request on the other device.

tvPair.error.notFoundOn.description: Android TV error when the entered code was not found on a server. {server}: the server name.

tvPair.error.providerUnavailable.description: Android TV error when the external sign-in provider could not be reached to confirm the account. The user is still signed in on the TV.

tvPair.error.signInFirst.description: Android TV error shown when approving another device without being signed in on this TV.

tvPairing.accountOnServer.description: Android TV line combining an account and server. {account}: the account name; {server}: the server name.

tvPairing.allow.description: Android TV button that accepts a nearby phone's setup or sign-in request.

tvPairing.card.consentNote.description: Android TV note on a side card, shown while waiting for the user to Allow; a code to compare with the phone appears after allowing.

tvPairing.card.noAnswer.description: Android TV side card heading for the failure state where the TV could not reach the address the phone sent.

tvPairing.card.noAnswerNote.description: Android TV side card note explaining the failure: the TV could not connect to the server address the phone provided.

tvPairing.card.notFinished.description: Android TV side card heading for a failed pairing state where setup or sign-in did not finish.

tvPairing.card.notFinishedNote.description: Android TV side card note in the failure state. {server}: the server name that was not signed in.

tvPairing.card.onPhone.description: Android TV side card heading telling the user the next step takes place on their phone.

tvPairing.card.onPhoneNote.description: Android TV side card note: on the phone, choose which accounts to send to this TV, then tap Continue.

tvPairing.card.onPhoneNoteSignin.description: Android TV side card note: the user should approve the sign-in on the phone.

tvPairing.chip.approving.description: Android TV small status chip above the headline: the phone is currently approving the sign-in.

tvPairing.chip.connected.description: Android TV small status chip above the headline: a phone or tablet has connected.

tvPairing.chip.consent.description: Android TV small status chip: a nearby phone is trying to set up this TV, and the user is asked to allow it.

tvPairing.chip.consentSignin.description: Android TV small status chip: a nearby phone is trying to sign in this TV, and the user is asked to allow it.

tvPairing.chip.waiting.description: Android TV small status chip: the TV is waiting for the user's phone to respond.

tvPairing.chip.working.description: Android TV small status chip: the TV is requesting a sign-in code from the server.

tvPairing.completedChooseAccount.description: Android TV message after pairing when several accounts were signed in, prompting the user to choose one. {count}: number of accounts.

tvPairing.completedNamed.description: Android TV message after pairing succeeded, before the profile screen appears. {servers}: the server name or comma-separated names.

tvPairing.completedNone.description: Android TV message after pairing, saying the TV is moving to the profile selection screen.

tvPairing.completedTitle.description: Android TV headline shown when pairing has completed successfully.

tvPairing.confirmDetail.description: Android TV instruction under the code: confirm that the phone or tablet shows the same code, then approve there.

tvPairing.confirmDetailAutomatic.description: Android TV text saying the phone or tablet verifies the code automatically, so the user need not compare it.

tvPairing.confirmOlderPhones.description: Android TV fallback note for older phone app versions that show match words instead of the code. {words}: the match words, such as a few random words.

tvPairing.confirmTitle.description: Android TV large headline asking the user to confirm on the phone. Line break is intentional.

tvPairing.confirmTitleAutomatic.description: Android TV large headline while the phone verifies the code automatically and the TV signs in.

tvPairing.connectedDetail.description: Android TV instruction under the headline: on the phone or tablet, choose which accounts this TV should sign in to.

tvPairing.connectedDetailSignin.description: Android TV instruction under the headline telling the user to continue on the phone or tablet.

tvPairing.connectedTitle.description: Android TV large headline telling the user to choose accounts on their phone. Line break is intentional.

tvPairing.connectedTitleSignin.description: Android TV large headline telling the user to continue on their phone. Line break is intentional.

tvPairing.consentDetail.description: Android TV dialog body when a nearby phone or tablet requests to sign in this TV. {server}: the server name.

tvPairing.consentNote.description: Android TV warning on the setup request: allow only if the user started setup on their own device.

tvPairing.consentNoteSignin.description: Android TV warning on the sign-in request: allow only if the user started the sign-in on their own device.

tvPairing.consentTitle.description: Android TV large headline asking whether to allow a nearby phone's setup. Line break is intentional.

tvPairing.consentTitleSignin.description: Android TV large headline asking whether to allow a nearby phone's sign-in. Line break is intentional.

tvPairing.consentUnencrypted.description: Android TV security warning shown when the server address uses plain HTTP rather than HTTPS. {host}: the server address, such as 192.168.1.5:8096.

tvPairing.continue.description: Android TV button to continue after a pairing step.

tvPairing.dontAllow.description: Android TV button that rejects a nearby phone's setup or sign-in request.

tvPairing.failedDenied.description: Android TV failure message when the phone's sign-in was declined. {server}: the server name.

tvPairing.failedExpired.description: Android TV failure message when the code expired before approval. {server}: the server name.

tvPairing.failedGeneric.description: Android TV failure message for an unknown error during pairing. {server}: the server name.

tvPairing.failedIdentity.description: Android TV failure message when the address sent by the phone reached a different server than expected. {server}: the name of the server the phone meant.

tvPairing.failedIdentitySignin.description: Android TV failure message when the phone offered a server that this TV does not use. {server}: the server name the phone offered.

tvPairing.failedTitle.description: Android TV headline when pairing for server setup failed.

tvPairing.failedTitleSignin.description: Android TV headline when pairing for sign-in failed.

tvPairing.failedUnreachable.description: Android TV failure message when the TV cannot connect to the server. {server}: the server name.

tvPairing.failedUpdate.description: Android TV failure message when a version mismatch blocks sign-in. {server}: the server name, which may need updating.

tvPairing.finishing.description: Android TV progress message while the phone or tablet completes the final pairing step.

tvPairing.signedIn.description: Android TV label for a successful sign-in when a single account was signed in.

tvPairing.signedInCount.description: Android TV headline after multiple accounts were signed in. Line break is intentional. {count}: number of accounts.

tvPairing.unreachableProvider.description: Android TV failure message when the server is only reachable via a network provider app such as a VPN. {server}: the server name; {provider}: the network provider app name, mentioned twice.

tvPairing.unreachablePublic.description: Android TV failure message when the server's public address does not respond. {server}: the server name; {address}: its public address.

tvPairing.unreachableTitle.description: Android TV large headline when the server cannot be reached. Line break is intentional. {server}: the server name.

tvPairing.useAlternate.description: Android TV button to retry with another server address. {address}: the alternate host address.

tvPairing.workingDetail.description: Android TV detail line while the TV requests its sign-in code.

tvPairing.workingTitle.description: Android TV large headline while signing in to a server. Line break is intentional. {server}: the server name.

tvPairing.workingTitleAccount.description: Android TV large headline while signing in an account. Line break is intentional. {account}: the account name; {server}: the server name.

tvSetup.phoneDetail.description: Android TV first-run setup text describing the phone method: open Silo on a phone or tablet on the same Wi-Fi and accept the setup card.

tvSetup.phoneLooking.description: Android TV first-run setup progress line while it searches for nearby phones or tablets.

tvSetup.phonePill.description: Android TV first-run setup pill label, in capitals, marking the recommended option of setting up with a phone.

tvSetup.subtitle.description: Android TV first-run setup subtitle offering two ways to connect: phone or tablet, or typing the server address with the remote.

tvSignIn.action.newCode.description: Android TV button on the sign-in screen that requests a fresh sign-in code.

tvSignIn.action.password.description: Android TV button that opens the username and password sign-in form.

tvSignIn.codeLabel.description: Android TV accessibility (TalkBack) label for the sign-in code displayed on screen.

tvSignIn.declinedLead.description: Android TV text shown after a sign-in was declined, replacing the scan instructions, telling the user to request a new code.

tvSignIn.error.accountDisabled.description: Android TV sign-in error when the user's account has been disabled.

tvSignIn.error.accountRequired.description: Android TV sign-in error when the person has no account on the server. The server admin must add them.

tvSignIn.error.cleanupIncomplete.description: Android TV message when sign-in worked but clearing local diagnostics data did not finish.

tvSignIn.error.emailInUse.description: Android TV sign-in error when an account with the same email exists but is not linked. {provider}: the sign-in provider name, such as Google.

tvSignIn.error.identityChanged.description: Android TV sign-in error when the account or server changed mid-process, so sign-in must restart.

tvSignIn.error.identityLinkedElsewhere.description: Android TV sign-in error when an external identity is already linked to another account. {provider}: the sign-in provider name, such as Google.

tvSignIn.error.invalidCredentials.description: Android TV password form error for a wrong username or password.

tvSignIn.error.invalidCredentialsProvide.description: Android TV password form error for wrong credentials, adding a hint for users who use an external sign-in. {provider}: the provider name.

tvSignIn.error.localLoginDisabled.description: Android TV error when the server has turned off password sign-in.

tvSignIn.error.loginFailed.description: Android TV generic error title or message when login failed.

tvSignIn.error.network.description: Android TV sign-in error for a network failure.

tvSignIn.error.networkEmailInUse.description: Android TV sign-in error when a network provider sign-in matches an existing account by email. {provider}: the network provider name, such as Tailscale.

tvSignIn.error.networkIdentityRequired.description: Android TV sign-in error telling the user to open the server through a provider's network address. {provider}: the network provider name, such as Tailscale.

tvSignIn.error.networkNotPermitted.description: Android TV sign-in error when the network provider blocks this device from the server. {provider}: the network provider name.

tvSignIn.error.networkProviderGone.description: Android TV sign-in error when a network sign-in provider was removed from the server. {provider}: the provider name.

tvSignIn.error.notPermitted.description: Android TV sign-in error when the account is not allowed to use this server.

tvSignIn.error.passwordExpired.description: Android TV sign-in error when the password has expired and must be changed elsewhere.

tvSignIn.error.passwordRequired.description: Android TV validation error under the password field when it is empty.

tvSignIn.error.providerUnavailable.description: Android TV sign-in error when the external sign-in service cannot be reached.

tvSignIn.error.rateLimited.description: Android TV sign-in error after too many failed attempts.

tvSignIn.error.saveFailed.description: Android TV sign-in error when the signed-in session could not be stored on the device.

tvSignIn.error.usernameRequired.description: Android TV validation error under the username field when it is empty.

tvSignIn.eyebrow.description: Android TV small label above the sign-in headline, for the account section.

tvSignIn.form.createAccount.description: Android TV button on the password sign-in form that starts creating a new account.

tvSignIn.form.hidePassword.description: Android TV accessibility label for the toggle that hides the typed password.

tvSignIn.form.passwordPlaceholder.description: Android TV placeholder text in the empty password field.

tvSignIn.form.providerHint.description: Android TV hint under the password form for users who normally use an external sign-in. {provider}: the provider name.

tvSignIn.form.showPassword.description: Android TV accessibility label for the toggle that reveals the typed password.

tvSignIn.form.submit.description: Android TV button that submits the username and password form.

tvSignIn.form.submitting.description: Android TV button label while the password sign-in request is running.

tvSignIn.form.title.description: Android TV title of the username and password sign-in form.

tvSignIn.form.usePhone.description: Android TV button on the password form returning to the phone-based sign-in with a code.

tvSignIn.form.usernamePlaceholder.description: Android TV placeholder text in the empty username field.

tvSignIn.nearbyHint.description: Android TV hint on the sign-in screen saying nearby phones with Silo on the same Wi-Fi can sign in this TV.

tvSignIn.network.continueAs.description: Android TV button that signs in with the identity a network provider (such as Tailscale) reports for this device. {account}: that identity's name.

tvSignIn.network.continueWith.description: Android TV button to sign in using a network provider. {provider}: the provider's name.

tvSignIn.network.via.description: Android TV small label showing the network provider used to reach the server. {provider}: the provider's name.

tvSignIn.passwordOnly.description: Android TV note that the server offers only password sign-in, not code or phone approval.

tvSignIn.providerFallback.description: Android TV fallback phrase used in place of a provider name when none is known. It is inserted into other sentences.

tvSignIn.qrDescription.description: Android TV accessibility (TalkBack) description of the sign-in QR code. {host}: the activation website address; {code}: the sign-in code read aloud character by character.

tvSignIn.sessionExpired.description: Android TV message when the saved session ended, prompting a new sign-in. {server}: the server name.

tvSignIn.status.couldntFinish.description: Android TV status when sign-in did not complete on this TV.

tvSignIn.status.denied.description: Android TV status when the sign-in request was declined.

tvSignIn.status.failed.description: Android TV status when requesting a sign-in code failed.

tvSignIn.status.gettingCode.description: Android TV status while the TV requests a sign-in code.

tvSignIn.status.newCode.description: Android TV status after a code refresh, while waiting for approval on the phone.

tvSignIn.status.opened.description: Android TV status when the user has opened the request on their phone and should continue there.

tvSignIn.status.paused.description: Android TV status when the sign-in process has paused.

tvSignIn.status.signedIn.description: Android TV status when sign-in succeeded.

tvSignIn.status.signedInAs.description: Android TV status when sign-in succeeded. {account}: the account name.

tvSignIn.status.tooMany.description: Android TV status when too many requests were made. The TV retries automatically.

tvSignIn.status.unreachable.description: Android TV status when the server cannot be contacted. {host}: the server's host name.

tvSignIn.status.updateRequired.description: Android TV status when the server's version is too old to support TV sign-in.

tvSignIn.status.waiting.description: Android TV status while the code is displayed and approval has not happened yet.

tvSignIn.step.approve.description: Android TV instruction step: approve the sign-in on the phone, after which the TV signs in automatically.

tvSignIn.step.scan.description: Android TV instruction step next to the QR code: scan it with a phone camera.

tvSignIn.step.url.description: Android TV instruction step: visit a web page and type the code. {url}: the activation website address.

tvSignIn.title.description: Android TV sign-in screen title. {server}: the server name.
